name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) clause is redundant. The other hard clauses (Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up)) already force has_door_key to occur before the required target pick‑up, making the conditional clause unnecessary. Remove the RespondedExistence clause to avoid an added, superfluous requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is redundant – the other hard rules (Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) together with the goal Existence(target_picked_up)) already guarantee that any successful run must include the key, so this RespondedExistence adds no new requirement and should be removed. Additionally, the hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) is not stated in the original task; the task only says “Then pick up the box”, which does not impose an explicit ordering of the key before the box. Adding this order creates an extra requirement that the task never asked for, so it must be removed. The correct clause set should be only RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) (hard) and Existence(target_picked_up) (hard).

texts: If the ball is moved (blocker_moved), the key must also be taken (has_door_key).
Eventually pick up the target box (target_picked_up).
The key must be taken before the target box is picked up (has_door_key precedes target_picked_up).
